problem_addressed: Off-policy distillation trains on teacher states rather than student states
mechanism: Student samples trajectories and teacher provides dense token-level feedback
uncertainty: Teacher logits and tokenizer compatibility can dominate cost

problem_addressed: One teacher does not cover all domains or stages
mechanism: Domain or stage-specific teachers supervise student rollouts
uncertainty: Official reports differ in detail and benchmark protocols

problem_addressed: Full rollouts and teacher scoring are expensive
mechanism: Stop early and distill informative prefixes
uncertainty: Prefix concentration may vary by task and response length

problem_addressed: Standard OPD has variance and weak-exploration failure modes
mechanism: Use asymmetric objective with local divergence minimization in non-positive advantage regions
uncertainty: Requires careful comparison against tuned OPD baselines

problem_addressed: Teacher-student distribution mismatch can destabilize gradients
mechanism: Limit OPD to reliable regions and handle outliers separately
uncertainty: Trust region thresholds may be model and task specific

problem_addressed: Agent next-state signals are richer than scalar rewards
mechanism: Extract hints from next state and convert them into token-level directional supervision
uncertainty: Online agent settings remain harder to reproduce than static math benchmarks

problem_addressed: External teachers may be unavailable or costly
mechanism: Use model self-generated reasoning and self-teacher style feedback
uncertainty: Teacher-free gains need stronger independent replication
